decisions.reason: Placing missing parts in the JLCPCB cart does not change the requirements for valid assembly part numbers or board-specific BOMs.
The procurement instruction does not change the requirement to validate component orientations in JLCPCB.
Adding missing parts to the cart does not alter the required PCB production export files.
The instruction addresses procurement of currently missing parts but does not modify the standing component sourceability or compatible-alternative policies.
The cart instruction has no effect on connector pin labeling or its board location.
Ordering missing parts does not change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, or connector-clearance constraints.
The procurement action does not change the interboard power topology, connector types, pin counts, or pinout rules.
Placing parts in the cart does not modify the three-board architecture or the roles of its boards.
The source decision concerns ordering missing parts and does not alter connector placement, orientation, or alignment.
The generic request to cart missing parts does not specifically modify the charge-status LED circuit or component population requirements.
The procurement instruction does not change ESP32 pin coverage, breakout format, or platform purpose.
Adding missing parts to the order cart does not change the monitored rails, INA topology, or spare-channel requirement.
